titulo: Boy, 11, in serious condition after being shot in face and neck in Sydney home
cuerpo: Five other people in house at the time of the shooting were unharmed, police say Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast An 11-year-old boy has been taken to hospital in a serious condition after being shot in a home in Sydney’s north-west.
